brief:
Hebron governorate held grape marketing days that drew significant crowds and participation from residents and local institutional representatives, the Palestine News Network reported. The event was organized by the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and its partners as part of broader agricultural promotion efforts.

Samah Abu Heikel stood with Palestinian farmers and women working in agriculture during the marketing initiative. The gatherings brought together farming communities across the West Bank region.
dek: HEBRON, West Bank / PNN / — The grape marketing days in the Hebron governorate drew large crowds and strong participation from residents and representatives of local institutions, as part of efforts by the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and its partners…
title: Palestinian agriculture official promotes grape marketing in Hebron
